decisions.summary: Strictly sequential: no launch while another run is live; the headroom gate (4.5 GB) reads the SHARED claude-containers.slice working set (memory.current less inactive_file) through host-diag with no offset, and a memwatch warning does not block while that figure is readable; fallback when the host cannot be read: this container's working set + a 1.9 GB offset with the 15-minute warning rule; the launch record names its source; nothing of the experiment beside a live run (revised at T09, cb50ba8e3)
decisions.why: Within. What was asked: the GM's amendment ('sequentially rather than in parallel for memory reasons ... I don't want too many things running to be a problem for the container') and the accepted spec (US2 AS5, FR-005, SC-006: one run at a time, a launch only under a stated headroom threshold, a logged wait otherwise, nothing else of the experiment beside a live run, the record showing memory under the threshold at launch). All of that stands. The memwatch-warning wait was never in the GM's words or the spec; it was the plan's own proxy, needed because the launcher could not see the capped figure. The revision reads the capped figure itself - the cgroup whose memory.max is the 9.0 GiB cap - which is closer to the request's purpose (a problem for the container is an OOM kill under that cap), not further from it; the warning's figure is that same cgroup's raw memory.current, page cache included, which the kernel reclaims before it kills. So nothing the GM or the spec asked for is narrowed. Re-read independently 2026-09-29 by this reviewer via host-diag: memory.max 9663676416, memory.current 7.56 GB, inactive_file 3.00 GB (working set 4.55 GB) - the source is readable and is the cap. The drafting drift noted in the previous round (plan.md Constraints line; contracts/cli.md step 1) was corrected in 1cfb0e131: both now say the memwatch warning blocks only on the fallback, matching research R5 D7 revised (lines 132-135); confirmed by this reviewer 2026-09-29.

decisions.why: Resolved in c6a4e9e5a: grep of prompts/*.md for effort|experiment|specs/293|xhigh|set aside finds nothing; the claims labels read "293 | ...", the T08 sentence reads "Lines for 293 that you did not write are not claims on your work", handoffs go to handoffs/293/, the R briefs are copied byte for byte to <clone>/handoffs/293/ and run from there so the page runner's PROMPT ("Read {brief} first") names a neutral path (test_effort_run asserts the path and byte equality), and the release line reads "293 | run <id> ended". This now ENFORCES FR-004 ("nothing about effort") rather than departing from it. Aside for the GM: the run environment still carries SPECIFY_FEATURE=293-effort-level-experiment and L7R_SOURCES_HOME under <clones>/.effort-293/<run>/, identical in both arms; FR-004 governs the prompt, so this is not a finding, but a tool that echoes either path would put the word in front of the session.
